thread:
Alex: quick ping — our gateway telemetry costs are spiking. thinking we need route-level sampling + transport-awareness (grpc vs json) to trim volume
Rita: agree. do we want uniform sampling or priority-based? e.g. higher sample for generate endpoints than for health checks
Sam: priority-based makes sense. also grpc streaming messages currently create a lot of tiny spans. we should sample at stream-start instead of every chunk
Marta: +1 on stream-start. for REST endpoints we can do prefix sampling (prefix of request body/token) to keep determinism for debugging
kevin: what about customer-tier? enterprise customers should have full fidelity for SLA debugging, while free-tier can be sampled down
Alex: exactly — propose policy: default 1%, per-route overrides, on-error=100%, on-latency>1s=50%, enterprise=100%
Rita: sounds good. UX question: how will this show up in console? metrics vs raw traces? ops wants sampled traces surfaced with a confidence/weight so dashboards don't undercount
Sam: we can attach a sampling_weight header to events and traces so aggregation can scale counts correctly. envoy-friendly header like x-rd-sample-weight
Marta: sample config sketch (yaml):
```yaml
sampling:
  default: 0.01
  routes:
    "/v1/generate": 0.2
    "/v1/embeddings": 0.05
  on_error: 1.0
  on_high_latency: 0.5
  enterprise_override: 1.0
  grpc_stream_policy: stream_start
```
kevin: nice. implementation notes: gateway should apply deterministic sampling using trace_id hash so we can reproduce decisions across retries/redirects
Alex: + deterministic sampling. also need to think about telemetry schema: protobuf vs json payload for sampled traces — protobuf smaller but adds complexity for frontend. any prefs?
Rita: backend prefers protobuf for wire cost, console frontend can still decode to display. we already have proto models for spans in infra repo
Sam: downside: adding protobuf means we need translators in the api-gateway for json endpoints. doable but adds CPU. tradeoff: network cost vs CPU cost
Marta: maybe hybrid: send protobuf for high-volume internal rails, send json for rare enterprise-full-traces to simplify tooling
kevin: or compress json aggressively (gzip) and use protobuf for streaming-heavy paths. keep it pragmatic
Alex: rollout plan: canary sampling change in staging > enable deterministic sampling > add sample_weight header > 2% prod for 24h > inspect dashboards > ramp per-route
infra-bot: Canary rollout started for sampling-policy v1 on cluster us-west-2 (canary pods: 3) :rocket:
Rita: also add a console toggle to preview sampling rules per-route (dev/debug mode) — product asked for it
Sam: I'll prototype gateway config and envoy filter tonight, and add deterministic hash function (xxh64)
Marta: I'll draft telemetry wire proto and fallback json schema, share in docs channel tomorrow
kevin: I'll add quota implications to billing thread — sampled vs unsampled metric counts for usage billing
Alex: sweet. if no objections i'll open the RFC and link implementation tasks
Rita: :thumbsup: go for it
kevin: :+1:
Sam: one more note — edge cases: batched requests (embeddings) should be sampled per-batch not per-item. avoid blowing up sample counts
Alex: good call. add batch-level sampling rule in RFC
Marta: ok i'll include examples and a small diagram for console UX
Alex: thanks team — moving to RFC now
